- 6 non-test callers outside the package: `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:356`, `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:85`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go:87,98`, `store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go:78`.
- ~31 additional callers in the package's own test suite (`internal/filter/engine_test.go`, `internal/filter/functions_test.go`, `internal/filter/time_test.go`), exercising the CEL-filter-to-SQL rendering pipeline across dialects.

This makes sense given `CompileToStatement` is the single funnel through which every CEL-based memo/attachment/shortcut filter expression gets compiled and rendered into dialect-specific SQL for SQLite, Postgres, and MySQL — so it's exercised by every filter test case as well as by each production call site that turns a user-supplied filter string into a `WHERE` clause.
